transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for gathering. We've got the festival trailer picture-locked at 60 seconds and it's going up this week, so we need to settle the music clearance today. The shortlist is down to "Static Bloom" and "Neon Weather." Before I make the final call and record the delivery package, I want to go around the room — rights, label, editorial, and festival-submissions leads, let's hear your findings on both tracks. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'll start on the rights side. I reviewed the executed publishing license for "Static Bloom" yesterday. The composition is cleared for use in the official trailer, but only for a cue of no more than 42 seconds, and the credit must read exactly "Written by Celia Voss." I haven't entered the terms in the clearance tracker yet, but I'm flagging it now so everyone's aware — especially editorial, since the trailer is 60 seconds and the licensed cue can't exceed 42.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: On the label side, I need to flag something critical about "Static Bloom." I confirmed with the master-rights owner that only the instrumental master of "Static Bloom" is cleared for this trailer — that's on a non-exclusive basis, limited to the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The vocal master is excluded, and any territory outside those three is also excluded. I should note this confirmation is still sitting in my email and hasn't been moved to the shared licensing folder yet, so I'll get it uploaded after this huddle. Combined with what Jonah just shared on the publishing side, we're looking at a 42-second max cue using the instrumental only, in three specific territories.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the editorial side, I need to share something I haven't circulated yet. I checked the locked picture and confirmed that the music cue begins at exactly 00:18 and runs for exactly 42 seconds. Changing either of those timings — the start point or the duration — would require reopening the approved picture lock, which we absolutely don't want to do with upload scheduled this week. So the picture is built around a 42-second cue, which lines up with what Jonah and Leila are reporting on the clearance limits for 'Static Bloom.' I just hadn't sent out a revised music note because the timings are fixed.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: On the festival-submissions side, I need to flag something critical that I haven't updated in the checklist yet. I confirmed with the festival upload vendor this morning that the trailer package must include a 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo WAV of the cleared instrumental and a completed cue sheet before the file can be accepted. The vendor added this requirement to the submission portal today. So whichever track Mara approves, we need to make sure the delivery package includes that WAV spec and a cue sheet, or the upload will be rejected.
transcript.speaker: A5

Ensure the completed cue sheet and 48 kHz 24-bit stereo WAV are included in the trailer package submitted to the festival upload vendor.
Update the festival-submissions checklist with the WAV spec and cue sheet requirement from the upload vendor.
